none: PAS CAM-E46F92: Roman Coin : Incomplete Copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is uncertain, c.AD335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse shows bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse shows two soldiers and probably ?one standard. Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 0.77g, diameter is 15mm
